editorial:
Imagine waking up and finding out your diet is basically killing you. That is exactly where Dave Stone finds himself in this wild ride. You get to follow this funny stand-up comic as he travels across the country to figure out why American food is so bad for us. It is a strange mix of a health documentary and a comedy show. During the day, you see him chatting with doctors and farmers to learn the truth about what we eat, and at night, he takes all those scary facts and turns them into jokes for a live crowd. It feels like you are on a road trip with a funny uncle who is trying to get his life together.

What really works here is how Dave keeps things light even when the health news is scary. The pacing is quick, and the transition from boring science to loud comedy keeps you awake. While some of the interviews feel a bit slow, the stage shows make up for it. If you like learning something new while laughing, you should definitely check this out. You can easily rent it on Apple TV for a movie night, or if you want the best picture quality, look for a 4K Ultra HD stream on Prime Video to see those greasy burgers in full detail.
endingExplained: By the end of the journey, Dave has a much better understanding of how processed foods ruin the body. He does not magically become a fitness model, but he makes a real effort to change his habits. The movie wraps up with him using his platform to warn others about their health through humor. He finds a balance between eating better and still being the funny guy everyone loves, proving that you can change your life without losing your personality.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves comedy mixed with real life health lessons.
